column_description: PRIMARY KEY (VARCHAR(20)) referencing actuation_data(ActReg). Identifies this system controller record uniquely.

JSONB column. Aggregates performance and environmental metrics of the system controller, including load, memory usage, thermal levels, and cabinet conditions.
Fields: {"cabinet_humidity":"NUMERIC(5,2) referencing cabinet humidity level as a percentage.","cabinet_temperature":"DECIMAL(6,3) storing the temperature inside the controller cabinet, if applicable.","load_value":"NUMERIC(4,2) measuring system or CPU load for the robot’s supervisory controller.","memory_usage":"REAL capturing memory usage (in MB or as ratio) of the system controller.","thermal_level":"FLOAT(5) approximate float for the controller’s internal temperature or thermal reading."}
